content.text: In countries like Zimbabwe, where conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-every-detail-you-3|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-methods-filipino-digital-creators-one-afternoon-fast|payment]] platforms like Stripe are severely restricted, digital creators face significant challenges in setting up online stores that can accept crypto [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-14|Tron USDT]]. However, with the advent of sovereign commerce infrastructure companies like COREMERCH, creators can now deploy their own digital stores on platforms like Cloudflare Pages for free, without relying on Stripe or other restricted services.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The infrastructure provided by COREMERCH works because it is built on a stack of free and open-source tools, including GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase. This allows creators to have full control over their store and its data, without being beholden to any single platform or service. Additionally, the use of NOWPayments for crypto payment processing means that creators can accept payments in over 300 different cryptocurrencies, without needing to worry about KYC or other regulatory hurdles.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, you will need to have a few key things in place. First, you will need to have a clear idea of what products you want to sell, and how you want to price them. You will also need to have a way to deliver your products to customers, such as through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, you will need to have a basic understanding of how to use the tools and services that make up the COREMERCH stack, such as GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Workers.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is a critical step in deploying your digital store. This involves configuring NOWPayments to work with your store, as well as setting up a system for delivering products to customers. With the Edge Commerce Stack, this process is streamlined and automated, allowing you to focus on creating and selling your products rather than worrying about the technical details of payment and delivery.
Deploy your digital store in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you have deployed your store and set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you are ready to go live and start processing transactions. This involves configuring your store to work with NOWPayments, as well as testing your payment and delivery systems to make sure they are working correctly. With the support of COREMERCH, you can get help with any issues that arise during this process, and ensure that your store is running smoothly and efficiently.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your store is up and running, you can start to think about scaling your operations to reach more customers and increase sales. This may involve optimizing your store for better performance, as well as using tools like Supabase to analyze customer data and improve your marketing efforts. With the sovereignty and control provided by the COREMERCH infrastructure, you can make decisions about how to scale your business without being limited by the constraints of a traditional platform or service.

You can learn more about this and other products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, and get started with deploying your own digital store today.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your digital store, start by setting up your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account, then configure your NOWPayments account and set up your payment and delivery pipeline. Next, deploy your store using the Sovereign Blueprint or with the help of COREMERCH, and test your payment and delivery systems to make sure they are working correctly. Finally, go live and start processing transactions, and use tools like Supabase to analyze customer data and improve your marketing efforts.
